title: Semantic Degradation Sentinel and Remediation Runbook
author: Maya Chen
content:
Overview
========

Purpose:
This runbook defines the design, detection thresholds, prioritization, and remediation steps for semantic degradation across model serving surfaces. It codifies a set of complementary sentinels and a fast triage flow for ML engineers and oncall evaluators to reduce customer-facing regressions tied to subtle semantic shifts (meaning, intent, hallucination frequency) rather than raw token-level metrics.

Scope:
- Applies to all text and chat LLM endpoints in hosted, dedicated, and private environments.
- Focused on semantic quality deterioration (not infrastructure outages or pure latency SLO breaches).
- Relevant for model promotions, quantized variant rollouts, and routing policy changes.

Definitions and concepts
------------------------
- Semantic Degradation Index (SDI): a composite score (0-1) that blends Anchor Consistency Score, Intent Preservation Rate, and Hallucination Frequency. Lower SDI indicates worse semantic fidelity.
- Anchor Consistency Score (ACS): fraction of anchor question-answer pairs whose canonical answers remain within the top-k semantic similarity window after a change.
- Intent Preservation Rate (IPR): percent of labeled intent buckets where the model preserves the original intent label under a paraphrase set.
- Hallucination Frequency (HF): rate of model responses labeled as hallucinations per 1k production queries in sampled traffic.

Design of Sentinels (detection signals)
--------------------------------------
1) Anchor-consistency sentinel (fast):
   - Input: curated anchor set (200–500 short Q/A pairs per workload slice).
   - Signal: ACS drop > 6 percentage points over rolling 24h triggers warning; >12pp triggers incident.
   - Rationale: catches subtle meaning drift while being robust to harmless fluency changes.

2) Intent-preservation sentinel (paraphrase sweep):
   - Input: for each anchor, 5 paraphrases (automatic augmentation + human validation).
   - Signal: IPR drop below 92% for critical slices (payments, auth, compliance) or 85% for general slices.

3) Semantic similarity delta sentinel (embedding-based):
   - Input: production sampling (1k requests/hour per shard latched).
   - Metric: median cosine similarity between baseline embedding and post-change embedding.
   - Signal: median similarity decrease > 0.03 for 3 contiguous windows -> investigate.

4) Hallucination sentinel (sparse human-in-the-loop):
   - Input: prioritized sampling (heuristic filter: high-certainty low-extractable, factual claims).
   - Signal: HF increase relative to baseline by 40% -> escalate.

5) Response-length / formatting regressions (syntactic guardrail):
   - Input: token-distribution histograms and structured-output validators.
   - Signal: sudden spike in invalid JSON outputs or format errors > 0.5% of sampled responses.

Thresholds and SLOs (recommended)
---------------------------------
(Use these as defaults; slices with higher business impact should tighten thresholds.)

| Metric | Warning threshold | Incident threshold | Collection window | Owner |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| ACS drop (pp) | 6 | 12 | 24h | applied-ml oncall |
| IPR (critical slices) | 92% | 85% | 24h | safety/product |
| Median embedding delta | 0.02 | 0.05 | rolling 6h | runtime team |
| HF relative increase | 20% | 40% | 24h | safety oncall |
| Invalid structured outputs | 0.2% | 0.5% | 1h | SDK/UX team |

Telemetry, sampling and signal hygiene
-------------------------------------
- Always tag sampled queries with route/model/quantization flags and prompt-template id.
- Use stratified sampling: 50% uniform, 30% heavy hitters, 20% user-facing critical slices defined in product configs.
- Maintain a 90-day baseline window and compute both short (24h) and medium (7d) deltas.
- Backfill gaps by replaying sync logs for rollouts where live sampling was insufficient.

Prioritization matrix for triage
--------------------------------
- Priority P0: SDI drop > 0.12 on critical slices OR ACS drop >12pp AND HF increase >30% -> immediate oncall war room (pager).
- P1: localized ACS/IPR drop affecting <3 routes or config variants -> 2-hour response SLA.
- P2: exploratory signal (embedding delta or format spike) -> 24-hour investigation window.

Triage runbook (step-by-step)
-----------------------------
1) Acknowledge alert in incident channel and attach: sample ids, model variant, rollout id, recent config diffs.
2) Rapid sanity checks (5–15 minutes):
   a) Confirm sampling tags and that comparisons used the correct baseline model and tokenizer.
   b) Check for infra anomalies: OOM spikes, GPU churn, or degraded quantization service logs.
   c) Run the anchor-consistency smoke script against live traffic (provided below).
3) Scope determination (15–45 minutes):
   a) Is the regression global (all routes) or isolated to a subset?
   b) Does it correlate with a recent model promotion, quantization profile, or routing change?
   c) Compare structured-output validators to detect format-only regressions.
4) Remediation decision tree (if P0/P1):
   - If correlated with model promotion: roll back to last stable model (see rollback checklist).
   - If correlated with quantization profile: switch route to float or higher-bit variant of same checkpoint.
   - If correlated with prompt change or template rewrite: revert template and re-evaluate on anchors.
   - If ambiguous: isolate traffic via canary routing to baseline model and increase probe sampling.
5) Closure: run a full anchor + paraphrase sweep and document SDI, ACS, IPR, and HF in post-incident notes.

Quick commands and snippets
---------------------------
- Run anchor-consistency smoke script (CLI):
  rwi eval anchor-check --baseline-model redwood/v2.1-stable --candidate-model redwood/v2.2-beta --anchors anchors/payments.json --out report.json

- Example alert payload (JSON) to attach to incident:
  {
    "alert_id": "sgd-2026-02-18-0912",
    "model": "redwood/v2.2-beta-q6",
    "route": "/v1/chat/generate",
    "sd_index_delta": "-0.145",
    "acs_drop_pp": "14.2",
    "samples": ["req-1234", "req-2345"]
  }

Rollback checklist (for model promotions)
----------------------------------------
1) Freeze new promotions in CI and pause any ongoing rollouts.
2) Update routing policy to send 100% traffic to previous stable model.
3) Re-run anchor + paraphrase sweeps; validate that SDI and ACS return to baseline.
4) Notify customers if impact exceeded SLA thresholds and file tickets as appropriate.

Remediation patterns and guidance
--------------------------------
- Prompt surgery: when degradation is confined to a few prompt templates, create targeted prompt rewrites, A/B test them against anchors, and deploy the best performing rewrite behind a feature flag.
- Quantization fallback: automatically reroute affected routes to a higher-bit or float variant while a quantization-specific investigation proceeds.
- Model patching: for deterministic faults (tokenization regressions, truncation), work with model-onboarding to produce a patched artifact and label it for a new round of shadow testing.
- Canary amplification: when signal is noisy, amplify canary sample rate for the suspect route to 10x to reduce time-to-confidence.

Escalation, ownership and communications
---------------------------------------
- Severity triage owned by applied-ml oncall for first 60 minutes; escalate to runtime/infra after 60 minutes if infrastructure correlation is found.
- Product and safety notified for P0 within 30 minutes. Customer success is included if any SLA breach is suspected.
- Postmortem: every P0/P1 incident must produce a short-form postmortem with SDI timelines, root cause hypothesis, remediation actions, and prevention recommendations within 72 hours.

Deployment and testing checklist for new sentinels
--------------------------------------------------
1) Create anchor set per route and validate labels with two annotators (kappa > 0.7).
2) Run shadow-scan against baseline for 7 days to compute baselines and variance.
3) Adjust thresholds by workload slice using 95th-percentile empirical variance.
4) Enable alerts in staging and run two simulated regressions (intent flip, hallucination injection) to verify alert fidelity.

Appendix: example anchor schema and annotator contract
------------------------------------------------------
- Anchor record (CSV columns): id, route, prompt_template_id, canonical_response, slice_tag, criticality_level, annotator_1, annotator_2, notes.
- Annotator contract (short): annotate only for semantic equivalence and intent bucket. Do not mark stylistic rephrasing as failure. Flag ambiguous anchors for triage.

Related pages and reference utilities
------------------------------------
- Tools: rwi eval, rwi sampler, rwi anchor-mgr.
- See also: continuity-runbook for shadow rollouts; eval harness longtail scanning docs for sampling heuristics.

Notes and future work
---------------------

- Long-term: integrate lightweight LLM-based triage assistant to pre-summarize candidate root causes and propose remediation steps for triage engineers.
